_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Terminate a session
operations.description: Terminate an active Devin session. This sends a stop signal to the session, causing it to gracefully shut down. Once terminated, the session cannot be resumed. Note: Sessions that have already exited cannot be terminated again.

operations.name: Delete knowledge
operations.description: Permanently delete a piece of knowledge by its ID. This action cannot be undone.

note_id.description: The ID of the knowledge to delete

operations.name: Delete playbook
operations.description: Delete a team playbook. Requires ManageOrgPlaybooks permission. This marks the playbook as deleted and removes any associated macro.

playbook_id.description: The ID of the playbook to delete

operations.name: Delete a secret
operations.description: Permanently delete a secret by its ID. This action cannot be undone.

secret_id.description: The ID of the secret to delete

operations.name: Terminate an existing session
operations.description: Terminate a running Devin session by sending a stop event. This will gracefully stop the session and prevent further execution. **Permission Requirements:** - If the `session-write-only-owner` feature flag is enabled for your organization, only the session owner can terminate the session. - Otherwise, any user in the organization with access to the session can terminate it. **Status Validation:**

operations.name: Get enterprise consumption data
operations.description: Retrieve detailed consumption data for an enterprise organization. Data is filtered by start and end dates in ISO format.

operations.name: Download attachment files
operations.description: Download a previously uploaded attachment file using its UUID and filename. This endpoint returns a redirect to a presigned URL for the file. **Note for curl users**: Use the `-L` flag to follow the redirect automatically.

operations.name: List all audit logs
operations.description: Get a paginated list of all audit logs for the current organization. The logs are ordered by creation date in descending order (newest first). Audit logs track various actions across organization management, sessions, API keys, secrets, knowledge management, playbooks, repository management, git integrations, enterprise settings, and search operations.

limit.description: Maximum number of audit logs to return

before.description: Filter logs before a specific timestamp

after.description: Filter logs after a specific timestamp

operations.name: List knowledge
operations.description: Gets all knowledge and folders in your current organization. This endpoint will not return system knowledge (repo indexes or built-in knowledge) managed by Cognition.

operations.name: List playbooks
operations.description: Retrieve all team playbooks accessible to your organization. Only team playbooks are returned via the API.

operations.name: Get playbook
operations.description: Retrieve details of a specific playbook by its ID.

playbook_id.description: The ID of the playbook to retrieve

operations.name: List all secrets metadata
operations.description: Get a list of all secrets metadata. This endpoint only returns non-sensitive information about the secrets, not the secret values themselves.

operations.name: List all sessions
operations.description: Get a paginated list of Devin sessions. The sessions are ordered by creation date in descending order (newest first). Each session includes its status, metadata, and any structured output from the latest events.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return per page

offset.description: Number of sessions to skip for pagination

operations.name: Retrieve details about an existing session
operations.description: Get information about the session's current status, timestamps, snapshot/playbook references, and any structured output.

operations.name: Upload files for devin
operations.description: Upload files via multipart/form-data. This endpoint returns a URL that can be referenced in session prompts or other requests.

operations.name: Create knowledge
operations.description: Create a new piece of knowledge.

body.description: The content of the knowledge. Devin will read this when the knowledge gets triggered

name.description: The name of the knowledge, used only for displaying the knowledge on the knowledge page

parent_folder_id.description: The id of the folder that this knowledge is located in. Null if the knowledge is not located in any folder

trigger_description.description: The description of when this knowledge should be used by Devin

pinned_repo.description: Pin knowledge to specific repositories. Valid values: - null: No pinning (default) - "all": Pin to all repositories - "owner/repo": Pin to specific repository

operations.name: Create playbook
operations.description: Create a new team playbook. Requires ManageOrgPlaybooks permission.

macro.description: Optional macro shortcut for the playbook (e.g., !deploy)

operations.name: Create a new secret
operations.description: Create a new secret in your organization. The secret value will be encrypted and stored securely.

sensitive.description: Whether the secret should be treated as sensitive

operations.name: Create a new session
operations.description: Create a new Devin session. Provide a prompt to describe the task. The session can optionally be made unlisted or idempotent.

snapshot_id.description: ID of a machine snapshot to use

unlisted.description: Whether the session should be unlisted

max_acu_limit.description: Maximum ACU limit for the session

secret_ids.description: List of secret IDs to use. If None, use all secrets. If empty list, use no secrets.

knowledge_ids.description: List of knowledge IDs to use. If None, use all knowledge. If empty list, use no knowledge.

tags.description: List of tags to add to the session.

title.description: Custom title for the session. If None, a title will be generated automatically.

operations.name: Send a message to an existing session
operations.description: Interact with an active Devin session by sending a message. This is particularly useful in sessions waiting for user input or confirmations.

message.description: The message to send to Devin

operations.name: Update knowledge
operations.description: Update the name, body, or trigger of a piece of knowledge.

note_id.description: The ID of the knowledge to update

body.description: The content of the knowledge. Devin will read this when the knowledge gets triggered

name.description: The name of the knowledge, used only for displaying the knowledge on the knowledge page

parent_folder_id.description: The id of the folder that this knowledge is located in. Null if the knowledge is not located in any folder

trigger_description.description: The description of when this knowledge should be used by Devin

pinned_repo.description: Pin knowledge to specific repositories. Valid values: - null: No pinning (default) - "all": Pin to all repositories - "owner/repo": Pin to specific repository

operations.name: Update playbook
operations.description: Update an existing team playbook. Requires ManageOrgPlaybooks permission. Only team playbooks can be updated.

playbook_id.description: The ID of the playbook to update

macro.description: Optional macro shortcut for the playbook (e.g., !deploy)

operations.name: Update session tags
operations.description: Update the tags associated with a Devin session.

tags.description: List of tags for the session
